title: Wall and coolant temperature

verification.reference: analytical constant-profile solution, energy/pressure balances and grid convergence tests

validity.valid_range: 10000 <= Re <= 100000; 0.7 <= Pr <= 160; path/Dh >= 10; t/r <= 0.1; declared single-phase limits

assumptions: Steady single-phase incompressible coolant; constant properties in a declared window.
Smooth fully developed turbulent channels; hydraulic-diameter approximation for rectangles.
1D planar ligament conduction; uniform circumferential temperatures.
Gas h and Taw prescribed; no gas energy or Bartz wall-temperature iteration.
Channel bottom only: rib/sidewall fin enhancement is not credited.
warnings: No boiling, supercritical properties, coking, roughness, manifolds, radiation, transient heating or thermal stress.
Only the supplied gas-side profile is cooled; no implicit chamber/convergent coverage.
Pressure loss and heat pickup are not a closed engine cycle balance.
Gas profile: existing SI Bartz correlation scaled by (At/A)^0.9; recovery Taw is computed from Pr, not set equal to Tc.
Gas h is frozen at the explicit thermal-stage wall-temperature assumption, not iterated with the predicted wall.
Coolant and film flow are explicitly specified streams, not deducted from Performance; cycle/mixture/heat-loss coupling remains open.
